channel.title: Laura Mathews Art
channel.description:
Artist and puppet maker obsessed with biological mechanics. 

I’ve been making string puppets since 2018, but I’ve been creating articulating animals ever since I can remember. I primarily laser cut and stack layers of wood, then carve the exterior surface. Over the last few years I’ve really got my teeth into the wonders of 3D printing too, using it to create interesting angled motion and pieces
